create_multiroom_env: create a MultiRoomEnv with configurable min and max number of rooms and max room size
run_multiroom_n2s4: run the MiniGrid-MultiRoom-N2-S4-v0 environment with 2 rooms of max size 4
run_multiroom_n10s10: run the MiniGrid-MultiRoom-N10-S10-v0 environment with 10 rooms of max size 10
review_room_class: review the Room class that stores top position, size, entry door, and exit door positions
review_gen_grid: review the _gen_grid method that recursively places rooms, draws walls, doors, and places the goal
